name: Priya
label: Lossless-focused Tidal-curious listener
who: I listen through wireless earbuds, Sony headphones and floorstanding speakers, and I care whether lossless actually sounds better. I use both Tidal and Spotify, and I stay on Spotify mostly for its features and recommendations.
value_for_money: Argues lossless would add costs that are passed on or cut profit ([14]); says cheaper services already offer lossless and Spotify should too ([7],[34]); says the lossless upgrade alone is not enough to make them leave ([17]).
loyalty: Stays for Spotify's features, recommendations and the years of library they would have to rebuild ([4],[17]); moves toward Tidal when sound quality matters more to them ([3],[16]).
pain_points: Lossless arrived late and the rollout is slow ([0],[31])
Lossless may not be true lossless on Windows or Android ([37])
Interface cluttered with sponsored content and stories ([3])
Lossy bitrate kept low despite requests ([6])
likes: Lossless sounds better to some on good headphones ([24])
Recommendations and a bigger selection of artists ([4])
Catalog of soundtracks and one-hit wonders ([15])
Features they do not want to give up ([17])
reasons_to_stay: They value Spotify's recommendations and wide catalog, which keep pulling them back after trying Tidal ([4],[15]). They also say Spotify's features are hard to give up while they use wireless earbuds ([17]), and that the sound difference on ordinary gear is small ([4],[28]).
tone: Detailed and analytical, often running side by side comparisons and skeptical of marketing claims.
